parametric_category_id.description: Category ID used with parametric filters.

value_ids.description: ValueId strings returned in FilterOptions.ParametricFilters from an earlier broad search.

sort_field.description: Optional DigiKey sort field, such as Price, QuantityAvailable, Manufacturer, ManufacturerProductNumber, MinimumQuantity, Packaging, ProductStatus, or Supplier.

includes.description: Optional DigiKey includes expression used to reduce returned fields.
